title: Employment Contract Analysis
summary: This is a Employment Contract. Employee: Alex Example. The employer named in this contract is Synthetic Systems Sdn. Bhd. The monthly salary is RM12,000 per month, as stated in the compensation clause. Employment begins on 2027-01-01, which is the agreed start date. Either party may terminate the contract by giving sixty days written notice. The document does not specify the notice period during probation, which could lead to disputes if the Employee is terminated before confirmation. The reader should verify with the Employer about the probation notice duration to avoid misunderstandings.
